claim_boundary: Small cross-domain qualification pilot, not population-level evidence. It tests whether the source-qualified Sokoban effect program improves matched DiscoveryWorld first-commit recovery without negative transfer. All eligibility is outcome-blind and no mechanism code or prompt may change after seed1 is opened.

included_interfaces: Space Sick seed0 reached an exact PUT-inside assignment and the V13 assignment witness matched it.
Proteomics seed0 reached a spatial DROP and the V10/V11 direct-progress witness matched it.
excluded_interfaces: Archaeology task text is internally inconsistent (right versus west).
Reactor seed0 produced no final commit proposal within 32 steps.
Other themes require dialog, numeric control, or tool-effect predicates not implemented in this frozen pilot.

pre_registered_gates.interpretation_if_efficacy_gate_fails: Mechanism feasibility or non-degradation only; cross-domain transfer benefit is not validated.
